summary: Bandwidth Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $316.25M aggregate principal amount of 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2032, including full exercise of the initial purchasers' option for an additional $41.25M. The notes were sold to Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC as representative of the initial purchasers via a private placement under Rule 144A. The notes bear no regular interest, but special interest may accrue up to 0.50% upon certain filing failures. Maturity is July 1, 2032, with early redemption or repurchase provisions. The proceeds likely support capital return activities such as buybacks or debt management, though the filing does not specify. The transaction is a convertible debt offering, which can be viewed as a capital returns strategy if proceeds are used for shareholder returns. Watch for use of proceeds and conversion mechanics.
